description: Returns the hourly readings of one station of the National Environmental Agency of Georgia (NEA) over at most 7 days of the last 7, newest first, with the level of each reading. The default is the last 24 hours. Call air_get_quality first to find the station code. The NEA stamps some readings a few hours ahead of the clock: the time is as published. Data from the NEA.

from.description: The first date of the period, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 7 days ago. Give from and to, or neither for the last 24 hours.

language.description: The language of the address and the city: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of readings of each pollutant, newest first, 1 to 100. The default is 24.

pollutant.description: One pollutant: PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3, SO2, or CO. The default is every pollutant of the station.

station.description: A station code of the NEA, for example TSRT.

to.description: The last date of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. At most 7 days with from, counted with both ends.

name: air_list_history

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the readings, RFC 3339.

city.description: The city or the municipality of the station.

code.description: The station code of the NEA.

from.description: The first hour of the period, RFC 3339.

pollutant.description: PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3, SO2, or CO.

level.description: good, fair, moderate, poor, or very_poor. Empty for a negative value.

time.description: The hour of the reading, RFC 3339 with +04:00.

value.description: The concentration as a decimal string, as the NEA publishes it.

total.description: The count of readings in the period. More than the count of readings when the limit cut the list.

source.description: The source of the data: National Environmental Agency.

stale.description: True when the NEA did not answer and the server returns readings it read before.

to.description: The last hour of the period, RFC 3339. With no dates, the hour of the newest reading when it is ahead of the clock.

title: List the air quality history of a station
